text:
Maya CS: Quick sync on ArborHealth private/VPC rollout. Customer finished peering but asking for a short checklist: minimal firewall ports for inference fleet, KMS key policy guidance, and steps to validate Splunk audit log forwarding. Can we list blockers and next steps? @Owen NetEng @Priya Security @Sam Solutions

Owen NetEng: Short ports list for their infra team:
- Ingress: 443 from LB subnet (10.8.32.0/24) to fleet ENIs only.
- Control-plane egress: 443 to our control-plane IPs (we'll share).
- Telemetry/metrics: 443 to telemetry.redwood.example.com via NAT.
- Optional: 22 to jump host only, and 5000-5002 TCP for internal probes if they require.
I'll attach a tiny Terraform snippet for the SG.

Priya Security: KMS guidance 10 rules: restrict CreateGrant/RetireGrant to our service principal; include STS condition for their log-delivery role; explicit Deny for DeleteKey except for org-admin OIDC role. Example (adaptable):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowRedwood","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDFO:role/redwood-inference-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"},{"Sid":"DenyGrants","Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":["kms:CreateGrant","kms:RetireGrant"],"Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:PrincipalArn":"arn:aws:iam::REDFO:role/redwood-inference-service"}}}]}
```
Also they must provide the IAM role ARN used by Splunk for delivery so we can bind it.

Sam Solutions: Proposed handoff runbook (short):
1) Customer adds SG rule for LB CIDR -> fleet 443.
2) Customer supplies Splunk HEC URL + token and delivery IAM role ARN.
3) We attempt ingest from staging forwarder; validate TLS cert CN and token validity.
4) Run 1-hour smoke: sample inference, verify audit events in Splunk, verify metrics and KV cache warm.
I'll draft rollback steps if we need to revoke peering or route changes.

infra-bot: CI: "arborhealth-preflight" 6/7 checks passed. Failure: splunk-hec-connectivity -> tls_handshake_error (CN mismatch) and 401 (token expired). Pipeline: https://ci.redwood/integrations/arborhealth/789

Maya CS: Action items:
- @Owen publish SG/Terraform snippet + NAT/control-plane IPs to the ticket (ETA today).
- @Priya update KMS example to include the STS condition for the customer's delivery role and add a short audit validation note.
- @Sam hold a tentative smoke on Wed 1011am PT, pending Splunk cert/token fixes.
Customer asked we standardize the minimal port list and provide a KMS example they can copy into their onboarding repo. I'll request a new HEC token with 90d TTL and certs matching their HEC domain.

Owen NetEng: Will post SG snippet and NAT IP list by 4pm PT.

Priya Security: I'll add the STS binding and a one-paragraph checklist for auditors.

Sam Solutions: Tentative slot booked, marking tentative until infra-bot shows splunk check green.

Maya CS: Thanks team 680
